none: PAS LANCUM-38EE96: Roman copper alloy denarius of Diadumenius dating to the period AD 217 to 218 (Reece Period 10)
contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ is M OPEL DIADVMENIVS CAES ; R/ is PRINC IVVENTVTIS

A Roman copper alloy denarius of Diadumenius dating to the period AD 217 to 218 (Reece Period 10). Cf RIC 4 (Macrinus). 102. The diameter is 25mm, and the weight is 10.53g. Obverse inscription is M OPEL DIADVMENIVS CAES and the reverse inscription is PRINC IVVENTVTIS
